args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua Beach)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for Hawaii sun)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and North Shore trip)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, beaches, and scenic spots)
- Travel documents (ID, tickets, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket or umbrella (Hawaii weather can be unpredictable)
- Snorkeling gear (or plan to rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor and shopping)
- Formal/casual attire for the Luau experience
- Spa-appropriate clothing for relaxation day
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit with basic medications
- Phone charger and travel adapter
- Cash and credit cards

Don't forget to check luggage restrictions before packing!
